name: Mod Manager Help Test
description: Integration test of the mod manager's help: opens the Mods & Collections hub on every level (mods grid, a mod's page, games gallery, scheme editor with a selected mechanic and mod, help panels) and checks that every visible button, toggle, list and input explains itself with a tooltip. Activated only by --itest=mod_help (with --frontend); --shots=<dir> saves every level.
